data.define: To wear many layers because it's cold.

misuse.text: Don't tell a friend to 'bundle up' in summer.
misuse.why: It means put on warm clothes.

data.l1_hook: 外は凍えるほど寒いよ。'bundle up'する準備はできた？
data.l1_ex: 「Bundle up」、外は凍えるほど寒いよ！

native.tip: “bundle up” = 厚着する. 例文: “Bundle up, it's freezing outside!”
